?Reserved on 14.07.2023
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:141785-Db
Court No. - 43
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 6833 of 2023
Petitioner :- Prof. (Dr.) J.A. Oliver And 9 Others

Respondent :- State Of Uttar Pradesh And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Anuj Srivastava,Sr. Advocate

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Singh,J.
Heard Shri Gopal Chaturvedi, learned Senior Advocate for the petitioners and Shri Manish Goel,
Additional Government General for the State.

The writ petition seeks the following reliefs:-
"I. Issue an appropriate writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing
the impugned First Information Report dated 02.02.2023 bearing Case Crime No. 64
of 2023 Police Station-Naini, District-Prayagraj, under Section 409, 419, 420, 467,
Prof. (Dr.) J.A. Oliver And 9 Others vs State Of Uttar Pradesh And 4 Others on 21 July, 2023

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180097707/
1

468, 471 & 120B of I.P.C.
Ii.

Issue any other appropriate writ, order or direction calling for the letter dated
24.10.2018 bearing no. 2347/67-Ksa-18900(7)/16 issued by the Department of
Agriculture Education and Research, Government of Uttar Pradesh and letter dated
23.01.2019 bearing no. Audit-2-2038/Ten-2-18-355 (20)/2018 issued by the Director
Local Fund Audit Department U.P., Prayagraj and quash the same."

The only contention of learned counsel for the petitioners is that two cases were registered; one pertaining to illegal appointments made in the Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture,
Technology and Sciences, Allahabad.
Another FIR has been lodged alleging financial irregularities in the same Institution.
A writ petition was filed challenging the FIR, which pertained to the alleged illegal appointments.
This writ petition was dismissed and the matter is now subjudice before the Apex Court.
It is therefore, contended that the instant writ petition, which challenges the first information report alleging financial irregularities be adjourned awaiting the decision of the Apex Court.

Shri Manish Goel appearing for the State has vehemently submitted that the matter, which is subjudice before the Apex Court may pertain to the same Institution but relates to a distinct and separate offence.

The instant impugned FIR alleges financial irregularities as regards the funds provided by the State to the Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture, Technology and Sciences,
Allahabad, which is a aided institution.

entities.text: Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture, Technology and Sciences
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The instant writ petition therefore, should not be adjourned awaiting decision of the Apex Court in the other matter, which alleges a separate and distinct offence.

From the submissions made, it cannot be disputed that the two FIRs; one impugned in the instant writ petition and the other, which had been impugned earlier, which writ petition was dismissed and the matter is now pending before the Apex Court allege distinct and separate offences.
Under the circumstances, therefore, we do not see any justification to adjourn the matter awaiting the decision of the Apex Court in and unrelated matter.
The prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioners is, therefore, turned down.
No other point has been pressed.
We have perused the impugned FIR and find that its allegations constitute cognizable offence.
The FIR therefore, cannot be quashed.
The writ petition is accordingly, dismissed.
